up-to-date: What is installed is what the source says is newest.
outdated: A newer file exists. A run would install it.
missing: Nothing with this file name is installed. On a fresh volume that is normal; on a running server it is either new, or a publisher who renamed the jar.
unsupported: The source answered and has no build of this for the Minecraft version the network runs. Nothing is installed and nothing failed. It stays on this list, so the day a build appears the next run picks it up.
mount-missing: The volume is not mounted in steward, so nothing can be said about it.
other: The source could not be asked. This is not the same as nothing having changed.

steward.people.begins-tip: Bought but not yet begun - a period is appended, never overwritten.

steward.people.day-is-day: A day is exactly 24 hours, not a calendar day.
